name: cure-cache-band
description: Shows above the prompt how long the prompt cache has left, the session's cache hit rate and misses, and what a cold next message would re-cache. Adds /cache.

ttl.title: Prompt cache TTL
ttl.description: auto infers it from your plan's rate limits; pick 5m or 1h when that is wrong. CURE_CACHE_TTL overrides it.
